turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hello! After he, she and it, add -s to the verb. Example: She works. For verbs like watch, add -es, and for words like study, change y to -ies.

Try this one. Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
